restaurant.publication: is_active = true AND coalesce(is_disabled, false) = false
restaurant.freshness: v_google_places_freshness freshness_state = current and recommendation_eligible = true

activity.publication: is_active = true AND coalesce(is_disabled, false) = false AND type = attraction
activity.freshness: v_google_places_freshness freshness_state = current and recommendation_eligible = true

attraction.canonical_id: bahamas_attractions.id returned unchanged as place_id and attraction_id

self_tour.publication: the view admits only cruise_itineraries.status = published
self_tour.canonical_id: cruise_itineraries.id returned unchanged as place_id and tour_id

island_contract.storage_alias_exception: published_cruise_itineraries may store legacy display values; nassau-paradise-island includes New Providence, Nassau, and Paradise Island

failure_contract.provider_unavailable: return provider_error and a deterministic honest response
failure_contract.zero_results: return no_evidence and a deterministic honest response
failure_contract.stale_or_unpublished: exclude the row and never expose its name or ID
